# Policy apps

**Policy apps** are not a Jamf object type. They are a convention: Self Service + packages, discovered and upgraded as one unit via `buddy app` / `apps(...)`.

Classic **Mac App Store** records are separate — use [`macapp` / `macapps`](/docs/docs/macapps).

## Agent rules

- List is approximate; call `app(name=…)` / `buddy app get` before mutate or upgrade.
- Do not invent Classic PUTs for app upgrades — use `app_upgrade` (or policy package / Self Service helpers).
- Wait until the target package is READY in Jamf (`package_wait_ready` / `package_ready`) before `app_upgrade`.
- Prefer `docs/apps` then named builtins via `buddyscript`; Classic Mac App Store is `macapp` / `macapps`, not `app` / `apps`.
- Platform-only auth cannot list apps (Pro `/api/v1/policies` via gateway returns 403); use an instance-surface auth.

## Facts

- List: `apps(filter?)` · `buddy app list` — Hybrid policy list + name heuristics; approximate
- Get: `app(name=…)` · `buddy app get` — Authoritative Classic XML classify
- Upgrade: `app_upgrade(name, version, …)` · `buddy app upgrade` — Dispatches by kind after package READY
- Discovery starts from policies whose **name contains `[SS]`**. List keeps Install…[SS] and/or install/cache siblings; inventory/config `[SS]` stubs are omitted. App slugs treat hyphens and spaces as equivalent (`claude-cli` ↔ `Claude CLI`). When v1 `triggerManual` is present, install siblings with a custom trigger are preferred.
- Jamf does **not** publish a Pro policy CRUD API; RSQL on `/api/v1/policies` cannot filter by Self Service (only `id`, `name`, `enabled`, `categoryId`, `executionFrequency`, `triggerCheckin`, `triggerManual`).
- Greenfield setup remains `setup_app_classic` in `stdlib/app_setup.buddy` / change batches — there is no `app create`.

## Kinds

### single

One Self Service policy with the Install package attached (often Ongoing)

Upgrade: In-place package swap + SS description version

### install

SS script (param4) calls `install-{app}`, `install-{app}-next`, or `{app}-install`; one enabled install policy holds the package

Upgrade: Create replacement install policy, disable prior

### cache

Same as install, plus versioned `cache-{app}-{version}` policies

Upgrade: Keep old cache; new cache + replace install; optional SS description bump

## Builtins

### apps

`apps(filter?)` or `buddy app list [--filter=…]`

Returns: list of summary dicts {name, kind, version, ss_policy_id, install_trigger, …}

#### Parameters (JSON Schema)

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "properties": {
    "auth": {
      "description": "Session override",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "filter": {
      "description": "Client-side substring on name/kind/version/trigger/package",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "surface": {
      "description": "Session override",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "tenant": {
      "description": "Session override; omit for process defaults",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "title": "apps",
  "type": "object"
}
```

- Name-index from one hybrid policy list ([SS] in name); kind/version may be approximate.
- Authoritative classify is `app(name=…)`, not the list row alone.

### app

`app(name=…)` or `buddy app get <name>`

Returns: dict (summary + linked install/cache policies)

#### Parameters (JSON Schema)

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "properties": {
    "auth": {
      "description": "Session override",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "name": {
      "description": "App identifier (e.g. santa, vscode)",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "surface": {
      "description": "Session override",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "tenant": {
      "description": "Session override",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "name"
  ],
  "title": "app",
  "type": "object"
}
```

- Classic XML classify (excludes inventory-only SS stubs).

### app_upgrade

`app_upgrade(name, version, package_pattern?)` or `buddy app upgrade <name> --version=… [--package-pattern=…]`

Returns: None

#### Parameters (JSON Schema)

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "properties": {
    "auth": {
      "description": "Session override",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "name": {
      "description": "App identifier",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "package_pattern": {
      "description": "Package name glob",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "surface": {
      "description": "Session override",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "tenant": {
      "description": "Session override",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "version": {
      "description": "Target version",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "name",
    "version"
  ],
  "title": "app_upgrade",
  "type": "object"
}
```

- Dispatches by kind — single in-place package+SS description; install PolicyPackage with disable-source; cache keep prior cache + replace install-next.

## CLI

### app list

Discover policy apps from Self Service policies

```
buddy [global-flags] app list [--filter=<keyword>]
```

#### Parameters (JSON Schema)

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "properties": {
    "filter": {
      "description": "Client-side substring on name, kind, version, trigger, or package",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "title": "app list",
  "type": "object"
}
```

- List is a fast name-index from one hybrid policy list; kind/version/trigger may be approximate.

### app get

Show one policy app (kind, linked policies, package)

```
buddy [global-flags] app get <name>
```

#### Parameters (JSON Schema)

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "description": "App identifier",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "name"
  ],
  "title": "app get",
  "type": "object"
}
```

### app upgrade

Bump app to a new package version by kind

```
buddy [global-flags] app upgrade <name> --version=<version> [--package-pattern=…]
```

#### Parameters (JSON Schema)

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "description": "App identifier",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "package-pattern": {
      "description": "Optional package name glob (e.g. *santa*2026.3*)",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "version": {
      "description": "Target version",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "name",
    "version"
  ],
  "title": "app upgrade",
  "type": "object"
}
```

## Examples

```python
def main():
    rows = apps(filter="santa")
    if not rows:
        return None
    detail = app(name=rows[0]["name"])
    # After the package is READY in Jamf:
    # app_upgrade(name="santa", version="2026.3", package_pattern="*santa*2026.3*")
    return detail
```

```sh
buddy app list
buddy app get santa
buddy app upgrade santa --version=2026.3 --package-pattern='*santa*2026.3*'
```
